stem: (Select TWO.) Harbor Analytics links one workspace to the main branch of its repository. Which two statements describe how runs behave in this workspace?

choices.text: The first run starts by itself as soon as the repository is connected
A commit merged into the linked branch queues a run without anyone starting it
A commit pushed to any other branch of the repository queues a regular plan-and-apply run in this workspace
A `terraform apply` typed on an engineer's laptop cannot execute remotely against it
Each run uses the files uploaded from the engineer's working directory

rationale: HCP Terraform automatically queues a run whenever new commits are merged to the linked branch of the workspace's repository. A remote `terraform apply` is for workspaces without a linked VCS repository, so a laptop apply cannot run remotely here. The first run of a new VCS-driven workspace is not automatic, because someone must trigger the initial run manually. The workspace is linked to one branch and ignores changes to other branches, so a push to another branch does not queue a regular run. In a VCS-driven workspace the Terraform code for a normal run always comes from version control, not from files uploaded from a working directory.
